items.headline: Hamas Agrees to Disarm in Phased Gaza Peace Deal Announced by U.S.
items.summary: U.S. officials announced a landmark agreement where Hamas and other armed groups agreed to disarm in phases alongside a planned withdrawal of Israeli military forces from Gaza [1.2.3]. items.headline: FIFA Launches Feasibility Study on Expanding 2030 World Cup to 64 Teams
items.summary: FIFA has initiated a fast-tracked consultation process to evaluate expanding the 2030 World Cup from 48 to 64 participating national teams [2.1.7]. The governing body is assessing the proposal's financial and logistical impact despite pushback from major continental soccer confederations regarding calendar congestion.

items.headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Breaks Box Office Preview Record
items.summary: The latest Marvel sequel, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, generated a record $72 million during Thursday preview screenings in North America, surpassing the previous record held by Avengers: Endgame [2.1.6]. The massive start positions the Tom Holland-led superhero film for one of the biggest global opening weekends in cinema history.
